name: issue-635-app-routes
description: docs/specs/app-routes.md, Tests: the packaged vimma-open, run as another program runs it, hands a link to the browser under test over the D-Bus remote (the harness gives the scenario a session bus of its own, and vimma-open a vimma that adds -profile). With config.toml's rules (tests/e2e/fixtures/app-routes.toml), `vimma-open --from teams <url>` opens the page in work by the app rule, above the domain rule that also matches; `vimma-open <url>` from the harness, whose process chain names no program a rule names, opens it in admin by the domain rule. The first workspace in config.toml, home, is shown at the start. A foreground link from another program switches to its workspace.
